title: Dramatic Light Portrait
prompt:

The light beam is precisely angled at 45 degrees, originating from a hard spotlight with a narrow barn door configuration, casting a clean-edged pool of light on the floor and partially illuminating the subject. The atmosphere is stark, modern, and intensely focused.

CHARACTER:
A male model wearing a sharply tailored, single-breasted wool suit in deep charcoal grey with a subtle herringbone pattern, paired with a crisp white dress shirt with spread collar and a slim black silk tie. He wears black leather Oxford shoes with a high polish. His pose is dynamic and confident, standing with his body turned at a three-quarter angle to the camera, one hand in his trouser pocket, the other lightly adjusting his cuff. His gaze is directed slightly off-camera into the middle distance with a contemplative, intense expression. Facial features, skin texture, age, and hair color must be preserved exactly as in the reference photo without any alterations.

OBJECTS AND DETAILS:
No additional props, allowing the clothing, light, and pose to be the sole focus. The key detail is the interaction of the suit's wool texture and the shirt's crisp cotton with the hard, directional light, creating pronounced shadows and highlights.

ATMOSPHERE AND MOOD:
Dramatic, powerful, and sophisticated. The mood is cinematic and enigmatic, conveying modern masculinity and confident authority through the interplay of shadow and precise illumination.

COLOR PALETTE:
A monochromatic palette dominated by deep blacks, charcoal greys, and stark whites, punctuated only by the warm tone of the model's skin under the tungsten or daylight-balanced studio light.

TECHNICAL PARAMETERS:
Lighting: Hard, dramatic Rembrandt lighting from a single source with barn doors to create the sharp diagonal beam, minimal fill to preserve deep shadows. Camera: 85mm prime lens, shot at f/2.8 to isolate the subject with slight background fall-off, shutter speed synced to strobe. Professional photography, high resolution, sharp focus on the eyes and suit details, raw photo, natural skin texture, 3:4 aspect ratio, photorealistic.
